After the destruction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had begun developing a new secret weapon for the Galactic Empire. Meanwhile, in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], some rumors have grown concerning "[[ghost ship]]s" attacking Rebel patrols.

Near [[Dreighton]], the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Corellia Star]]'' was '''attacked''' by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and sent a distress call to Rebel pilots [[Kirby]] and his wingman, [[Rookie One]]. The [[Unidentified captain (Corellia Star)|pilot]] claimed to have crucial information about the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] new project.

When the Imperials boarded the freighter, the message ended abruptly. Then the two Rebel pilots saw on their [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] waves of TIEs approaching against them. The pair fought off the incoming waves and were ready to approach the planet when laser shots [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|came from nowhere]] against them. The first shots blasted off one of Rookie One's wings and its fighter lost its stability. As his B-wing descended helpless on the planet, the lasers shot Kirby down. Rookie One, however, managed to safely eject his [[Ejector seat/Legends|pilot pod]] and was left alone on the planet Dreighton.

[[File:CorelliaStar.png|thumb|left|[[Rookie One]] escapes the [[Imperial mining base]] with the ''[[Corellia Star]]''.]]

Having no other means to escape the planet, Rookie One used his [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] to trace the freighter. He was led to an [[Imperial mining base|Imperial facility]] and fought his way through, eventually reaching the ''Corellia Star'' and killing the stormtroopers who were guarding the ship. He escaped the base by flying through mining tunnels and delivered it to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].

==Aftermath==
In the ''Corellia Star's'' records, the Alliance learned about a secret Imperial mining facility in the [[Arah asteroid belt|Belt of Arah]] and a [[Rascal Squadron|squadron]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] moved in to [[Battle of Arah|destroy]] it.
